answer: To enforce anti-Sybil equilibrium, the raven protocol mandates a quadratic slashing commitment that burns malicious staked assets. This forces marginal attack costs to scale super-linearly, ensuring that any rogue beacon node attempting a collusion exploit faces exponential capital erosion. Consequently, even if an ember of adversary incentive persists, the required capital lockup guarantees that the cost of corruption strictly exceeds any potential extracted value.
